unit_tests.name: Wind Stress Calculation under Moderate Trade Winds
unit_tests.physical_interpretation: Southeasterly trades (8.49 m/s) generate ocean wind stress ~0.12 N/m^2 pointing northwestward.

unit_tests.name: Southern Hemisphere Ekman Transport Deflection (90 deg to Left)
unit_tests.physical_interpretation: In Southern Hemisphere (f < 0), Ekman mass transport deflects exactly 90 degrees to the left of the wind vector.

unit_tests.name: Ekman Pumping Sign & Upwelling Velocity in South Java
unit_tests.physical_interpretation: Anticyclonic wind stress curl in Southern Hemisphere yields positive w_E (>0), indicating vertical upwelling of ~2.0 m/day.

unit_tests.name: SST Frontal Gradient with Geodesic Metric Distance
unit_tests.physical_interpretation: A 3.0°C temperature drop across 22.2 km produces a robust frontal gradient of 0.1348°C/km (well above the 0.035°C/km thermal front threshold).

unit_tests.name: Surface Velocity & Eddy Kinetic Energy Derivation
unit_tests.physical_interpretation: Current velocity is 0.696 m/s; high EKE (1212.5 cm^2/s^2) confirms strong mesoscale eddy activity relative to monthly climatology.

unit_tests.name: Bathymetric Slope across Java Trench Continental Margin
unit_tests.physical_interpretation: Steep continental slope of 6.2° (10.86% grade) represents the steep subduction zone boundary off South Java.
